title.narrative: North Karnataka Urban Sector Investment Program - Project 4

description.narrative: Project 4 under the Investment Program (the Project) supports improvements in sanitation, water supply and municipal infrastructure in the following 14 ULBs: Basavakalyan, Badami, Bellary, Bidar, Gadag-Betegeri, Gokak, Haveri, Hospet, Ilkal, Nippani, Raichur, Shahabad, Sindhanur and Yadgir and institutional development, improved municipal management and project implementation capacity for the Investment Program ULBs.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved urban service delivery in 14 ULBs in North Karnataka
Mainstreaming 24/7 PBMC in the water delivery (baseline = 0; target = 12 ULBs) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Household coverage of improved sewerage (from 20% in 2013 to 60% in 2017 on average) for 3 target ULBs, to include poor and FHHs Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports, ULB Statistics Actual value:
Supply volume per capita per day increased (Target: 100 lpcd, from average 60 lpcd in 2013) Data Source: ULB and SPCB reports Actual value:
Household coverage for improved water supply (from 64% average in 2013 to 91% in 2017 on average) for 12 target ULBs, to include poor and FHHs Data Source: ULB Statistics Actual value:
Sewerage discharge meets KSPCB standards (baseline: non-compliant) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports, ULB Statistics Base year: 2013 Baseline value: N
Water supplied to GOI water quality standards (baseline: non-compliant) Data Source: ULB and SPCB reports Base year: 2013 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Enhanced project management and implementation capacity Indicator: Project implementation training on safeguards delivered to project staff, consultants and contractors (Target: >150; F:M 25:75). Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS Actual value:
Output: Expanded sewerage infrastructure Indicator: 45,000 additional HHs served with sewers in 3 ULBs, including poor and F HHs (8-15%) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Expanded sewerage infrastructure Indicator: New sewers constructed (Target: 295 km) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Expanded sewerage infrastructure Indicator: Wastewater treatment capacity increased (Target: 51 MLD) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Improved roads and lake development infrastructure Indicator: Drains/interceptors improved (Target: 1.6 km) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Improved roads and lake development infrastructure Indicator: Urban roads upgraded in program ULBs (Target: 6 km) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:

Output: Strengthened service delivery management capacity Indicator: Capacity development program in PPP and performance based contracting delivered to project staff, consultants and contractors (Target: >150; F:M at least 25:75). Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and SIUD Reports Actual value:

Output: Strengthened service delivery management capacity Indicator: Skills development training towards plumbing certification developed and delivered to contractors (Target: >120; F:M at least10:90). Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and SIUD Reports Actual value:
Output: Upgraded water supply network Indicator: 128,000 additional HHs connected to water network, including poor and FHHs (3-15%) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Upgraded water supply network Indicator: New HH meters installed (289,000) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Upgraded water supply network Indicator: PBMCs in ULBs (baseline: 0 ULB, target: 12 ULBs) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Upgraded water supply network Indicator: Reservoirs rehabilitated and new (Target: 29 ML) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
Output: Upgraded water supply network Indicator: Water supply pipes installed or rehabilitated (Target: 1800 km) Data Source: KUIDFC PPMS and reports Actual value:
